article:
For each question, write the correct answer. Write one word for each gap.

[--- Table Start ---]
| Book review I've just finished reading Sara Tyler's latest book, Gold River. I think that it's even better than her last book. If you're looking (27)…………… an interesting book to read, then this (28)…………… the perfect choice. The main characters are described in a lot of detail, and I really cared about (29)…………… happened to them. If you're one of the thousands of people who have enjoyed other books (30)…………… Sara Tyler, you'll already know that some of her novels were made into films (31)…………… a few years ago. I wouldn't be surprised if this happens to Gold River, too. Although this book has new characters, (32)…………… is set in the same place as her other stories, so you might recognise some of the locations. Go and read it - I promise you won't regret it! |
[--- Table End ---]

explanations.27:
原因：“look for” 固定搭配，表 “寻找”，指寻找有趣的书。
词汇点：look for 强调动作，find 强调结果，如 “I'm looking for my keys, but I can't find them.”
explanations.28:
原因：主系表结构，“this is the perfect choice”，this 指代前文 book，用单数谓语 is。
语法点：单数主语 + is，如 “This book is interesting.”
explanations.29:
原因：宾语从句 “what happened to them”，what 作主语，表 “发生了什么”。
语法点：what 引导宾语从句，在句中作主语 / 宾语，如 “Do you know what he wants?”
explanations.30:
原因：“books by Sara Tyler” 表 “由 Sara Tyler 写的书”，by 表 “由…… 创作”。
词汇点：by + 作者 / 执行者，如 a novel by Dickens（狄更斯的小说）。
explanations.31:
原因：“in a few years ago” 表 “在几年前”，in + 时间段 + ago 表过去时间。
语法点：in + 年 / 月 / 时间段 + ago，如 in 2020, in March, in three years ago.
explanations.32:
原因：指代前文 book，“it is set in the same place”，避免重复。
语法点：it 指代同名同物，如 “I have a book. It is interesting.”
